title: Kenneth Arnold's 1947 craft matched Horten design

tellings.quote: kind that that Kenneth uh um Arnold saw you know in 1947. The same design without him knowing at the time

related.note: Same 1947 Kenneth Arnold sighting, but this telling claims the craft matched the Horten brothers' design, which recasts the object as a human-built craft.

plain: The objects that the pilot Kenneth Arnold reported seeing in the sky in 1947, a sighting that started the modern UFO era, had the same design as the flying-wing aircraft built by the Horten brothers, two German designers of the Nazi era. The writer Peter Levenda tells Michels this, saying it was "the same design without him knowing at the time." If so, what Arnold saw may have been a craft built from German wartime designs.
